MakeItOurs Hosted

Pre-launch.

MakeItOurs is in staging testing. Public accounts are not available yet, and features marked “Coming soon” are not released.

MakeItOurs works two ways. With Bring Your Own Infra (BYOI), your projects live in your own GitHub account and use your own AI provider, and the app helps you connect both. BYOI is a capable choice. With Hosted, MakeItOurs runs and manages that for you, and adds the features below.

Plans and pricing

Pricing coming soon. Plan names, prices and terms will appear here once they match the App Store.

Plans are bought in the MakeItOurs app through the App Store, not on this site:

  • Subscribe: open Account Management in the app and choose a plan.
  • Restore Purchases: on a new Mac or iPhone, choose Restore Purchases in Account Management.
  • Manage or cancel: choose Manage Subscription in the app, or use your Apple ID subscriptions.

What Hosted includes

Your perspective

Keep the angle you love. Turn your captured view into images and documents.

What you get
Images and documents from the exact view you framed.
How to use it
Frame the model, choose Capture view, review the picture, then pick the files you want.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI opens the documents its last build made. Hosted makes new ones from your current camera angle on request.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Perspective files show what is on screen. Standard plan and elevation drawings are a separate choice.

Individual elements

Just the part you need. Isolate a part and generate documents specifically for it.

What you get
Documents for just the part you care about.
How to use it
Use Layers or Isolate so only that part is visible, then capture the view and request documents.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI documents cover the whole design as built. Hosted generates them for the visible parts.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
What is visible decides what is included. Selecting a part alone does not hide the rest.

Point at the exact part

Point at the exact part. Type @ in Hosted chat to name the element you mean.

What you get
Changes go to the exact element you picked, even when several share a name.
How to use it
Type @ in the message bar, pick the element from the list (its group shows beside the name), then finish your message.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI chat finds elements from your description. Hosted sends the element's stable ID and checks it before the change runs.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
You pick from the version on screen. A renamed element is followed by its ID; if it was removed in a newer version, you are asked to pick again.

Focused drawings

Drawings with a tighter focus. Generate plan, front, side or section drawings of visible parts.

What you get
Plan, front, side and section drawings of the parts in view.
How to use it
Show the parts you want, open Documents and choose the drawing views.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI has the drawings from its last build. Hosted makes new, focused drawings on request.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Drawings are design aids, not engineering approval or permit documents.

Subset exports

Export the parts that matter. Generate STEP, IFC or GLB files for the parts in view.

What you get
STEP, IFC or GLB files for only the parts you need.
How to use it
Hide what you do not need, open Documents and choose a model export format.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI builds these formats for the whole design. Hosted generates them for a chosen subset.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Exports cover the visible parts in the formats listed.

Managed AI

More creating. Fewer keys. Use AI without managing provider API keys.

What you get
AI that works without provider API keys.
How to use it
Sign in and start a project. MakeItOurs connects the AI for you.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
With BYOI you bring and pay for your own AI provider account and keys.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Your plan's usage limits apply. The models offered can change.

Infrastructure and performance

Your ideas. Our infrastructure. Hosted runs your projects and their compute-intensive work.

What you get
Hosting and the compute-heavy work run by MakeItOurs.
How to use it
Ask for a change. Builds, checks and your project site run on MakeItOurs servers.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI runs on your own GitHub and provider accounts, which you set up and look after.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Build times depend on the change you ask for.

A simpler start

Start with an idea. No GitHub or AI provider account setup needed.

What you get
Start designing without setting up developer accounts.
How to use it
Sign in with Apple, choose a plan and create a project.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI needs a GitHub account and an AI provider account, which the app helps you connect.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
You still need an Apple ID and a MakeItOurs sign-in.

One plan, both devices

One plan. Wherever you make. Your subscription and projects follow you on Mac and iPhone.

What you get
One plan and the same projects on Mac and iPhone.
How to use it
Sign in with the same account on both. Use Restore Purchases if a device does not show your plan.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI projects also open on both devices through GitHub. Hosted keeps the plan and projects on your account.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Manage or cancel the plan from your Apple ID subscriptions.

Make it together Coming soon

One project. One conversation. Share a project, with messages and context together.

What you get
Share a single project, with everyone's messages and context together.
How to use it
Invite people to a project. Their messages, requests and activity appear together, like a group chat.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI collaborators share through GitHub access to the repository.
Availability
Coming soon.
Good to know
Roles, removing access and whose plan is used will be explained when this ships.

Safe teamwork

Everyone contributes. In order. Project changes are applied one at a time to protect your work.

What you get
Several people can ask for changes without overwriting each other.
How to use it
Send your request. If someone else's change is running, yours waits its turn and you can see it queued.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI changes land in your GitHub repository, where you manage conflicts yourself.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Changes run one at a time, not as live co-editing. A change that fails leaves earlier work in place.

Shared knowledge retrieval Coming soon

Find a proven starting point. Agents retrieve useful design patterns and code efficiently.

What you get
Agents start from proven design patterns and code.
How to use it
Nothing to set up. Agents search shared examples while they plan your change.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI agents work only from your own project.
Availability
Coming soon.
Good to know
Only published designs whose owners have not opted out are used. Your designs are not used to train models.

Image-guided design

Build from your reference. Hosted interprets images, guides planning and checks the result.

What you get
A guided workflow that turns a reference image into a design.
How to use it
Attach a photo or sketch to your request. Hosted plans from it and checks the model against it.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI can accept images if your AI provider supports them. Hosted adds the guided planning and checking.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Some details in an image may not be clear enough to model. You agree to how images are handled before the first upload.

Keep making

Pick up where you left off. Hosted saves progress so interrupted work can continue.

What you get
Interrupted work picks up from the last saved step.
How to use it
If a run is cut off or fails, open the request and choose Try again.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI retries inside a run, but a run that stops starts over.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Some failures still need a new request, and retries can use your plan's usage.

Published versions

An earlier version. A fresh start. Return to a previously published version of your project.

What you get
Go back to an exact earlier published version.
How to use it
Open Versions, choose one, review it and confirm. Hosted checks and publishes it again.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI keeps history in your GitHub repository.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Very old versions may need a tool update before they can be published again.

Coordinated tool updates

Keep your tools in step. Update your project’s CAD tools together in one step.

What you get
Your project's CAD tools kept current in one step.
How to use it
When an update is offered, review it and confirm. Hosted checks the project with the new tools.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
BYOI has Upgrade Project, which you run on your own setup.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
Updates never happen without your confirmation. If checks fail, your project stays on its current tools.

Watched for you

We keep an eye on the work. Failed runs alert the MakeItOurs team to investigate.

What you get
The MakeItOurs team hears about failed runs.
How to use it
Nothing to do. When a run fails, the team is alerted and looks into it.
Compared with Bring Your Own Infra
With BYOI, failures show in your own GitHub and provider accounts.
Availability
Included with Hosted.
Good to know
An alert means we look into it. It is not a guaranteed fix or response time.
